objections.quote: We've got three years of events in Mixpanel. What does moving all that actually cost us?
objections.betterAnswer: Ask what they actually query from those three years. Most teams look at the last 90 days. Import what matters, start fresh on the rest, and run both for a sprint.

objections.quote: Our event names are a mess. Do we have to clean that up first?
objections.betterAnswer: No. Migrate as is, then fix the names that matter once you can see which ones people use.

objections.quote: I can't tell what we'd pay once we add replay and flags.
objections.betterAnswer: Open the pricing calculator with them on the call and plug in their real volumes. Most teams land inside the free tier on at least one product.

talkTrack.opener: Most teams that switch from Mixpanel are not unhappy with analytics. They are tired of paying for five tools that do not talk to each other.
discoveryQuestions: Which Mixpanel reports does your team open every week?
How far back do those reports actually look?
What else do you pay for next to Mixpanel today?
Who owns event naming right now?
What would make a two-week trial a success for you?
proofPoints: The prospect said they already pay separately for session replay and feature flags.
